commands.name: list-announcements
commands.summary: List Digitraffic announcements (tiedotteet), newest first. You can filter by traffic type or tag.

commands.name: get-announcement
commands.summary: Get the full text of one announcement by date and slug, as found in the URL /tiedotteet/YYYY/MM/DD/slug.html.

commands.name: get-service-status
commands.summary: Get the current status (ok/disrupted/down) of every Digitraffic API system.

commands.name: list-status-issues
commands.summary: List incidents on the status page (outages, disruptions), newest first, with their resolution state.

commands.name: list-traffic-messages
commands.summary: List current road traffic messages (announcements, road works, weight restrictions, exempted transports) as GeoJSON features.

commands.name: get-traffic-message
commands.summary: Get one road traffic message by its situationId, e.g. GUID50xxxxxx (take the id from list-traffic-messages).

commands.name: list-weather-station-data
commands.summary: Get the latest sensor readings from all road weather stations.

commands.name: get-weather-station-data
commands.summary: Get the latest sensor readings (air/road temperature, wind, etc.) for one road weather station.

commands.name: get-tms-station-data
commands.summary: Get live traffic measurement data (vehicle counts, average speeds) for one TMS station.

commands.name: list-weathercam-stations
commands.summary: List all road weather camera stations, with location and state.

commands.name: get-weathercam-station
commands.summary: Get one weather camera station by id, including camera presets and image URLs.

commands.name: list-maintenance-routes
commands.summary: Get the latest road maintenance tracking points (snow ploughing, salting, etc.) as GeoJSON.

commands.name: list-station-live-trains
commands.summary: List live trains arriving at and departing from a railway station, by station short code (e.g. HKI, TPE).

commands.name: list-trains-between-stations
commands.summary: List the next trains running from one station to another, by station short codes.

commands.name: get-train
commands.summary: Get one train's timetable and live status by departure date (or 'latest') and train number.

commands.name: get-train-composition
commands.summary: Get a train's composition (locomotives, wagons, length, max speed) by departure date and train number.

commands.name: list-rail-stations
commands.summary: List all railway stations with short codes, names, UIC codes and coordinates.

commands.name: list-train-locations
commands.summary: Get the latest GPS location and speed of every running train.

commands.name: list-vessel-locations
commands.summary: Get the latest AIS vessel positions (GeoJSON). You can filter by MMSI or by a radius around a point.

commands.name: get-vessel
commands.summary: Get AIS vessel metadata (name, call sign, IMO, ship type, destination) by MMSI.

commands.name: list-port-calls
commands.summary: List port calls (vessel arrivals and departures) for a port, by UN/LOCODE (e.g. FIHEL).

commands.name: list-sea-state
commands.summary: Get the latest sea state estimation (SSE) measurements from coastal sites: wind, wave, sea state.

commands.name: list-aton-faults
commands.summary: List current faults in aids to navigation (buoys, lights, beacons) in Finnish waters.
